perspectives.title: has anyone managed to *convert* their KYC to NRI in CVL KRA for mutual funds?
perspectives.snippet: Top comment · Your AMC representative is being silly. They have the capability to update your KYC residence status. They need you to submit certain proofs but that's about it. The registrar can also do the same operation, but the AMC can also do this. If your portfolios are straightforward (individual, not joint, not HUF) you can log in to MFCentral and submit the service request with a cancelled cheque of your NRO account. MFCentral is a tool mandated by SEBI from the duopoly of the two mutual fund registrars. As such, you just need to login with your PAN. You don't need to sign up, you don't need to give them any extra portfolio details. Your existing folio details should already be visible on the portal. You can only convert Resident to NRO. Be sure to have your bank KYC updated to NRO first.
